description: Self-issue an AllRatesToday API key with 100 lifetime calls, valid 7 days, with no account and no email. Use it when another tool answered "needs an API key" and the user wants real-time rates, history, dated central-bank tables or cross-bank comparison right now. The key is returned once — store it, then reconnect to https://allratestoday.com/api/mcp?api_key=<key> (or send `Authorization: Bearer <key>`); this stateless server cannot adopt the key mid-session. Capped at 3 keys per IP per day. For a lasting key, register at https://allratestoday.com/register (free, 300 calls) or see https://allratestoday.com/pricing.

agent.description: Optional: the agent or product requesting the key.

purpose.description: Optional: one line on what the rates are for.
